rationale: Vadim is building Arcasave in the AI travel space with a strong product-driven, data-first approach honed across travel, foodtech, and fitness platforms. Marceli's expertise in user-centered design and digital experiences at Huge Design would directly complement Vadim's need to translate product strategy into intuitive, well-designed customer experiences—especially valuable as Arcasave scales its product surface.
intro_message: Marceli Rogała, meet Vadim — he's a founder in AI travel with deep product and growth experience, and could benefit from your user-centered design perspective as he builds out Arcasave.
